name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400c.ramanujanSum_squarefree
header:
theorem ramanujanSum_squarefree (q m : ℕ) (hq : Squarefree q) :
    ramanujanSum q m = ((Nat.gcd q m).totient : ℂ) *
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q m) : ℂ)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. On squarefree moduli the Ramanujan sum factors at the common divisor. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400c.ramanujanSum_squarefree_formula
header:
theorem ramanujanSum_squarefree_formula (q m : ℕ) (hq : Squarefree q) :
    ramanujanSum q m = ((q.totient : ℝ) *
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q m) : ℝ) /
        (q / Nat.gcd q m).totient : ℂ)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. The printed totient and Mobius formula holds on every squarefree modulus. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400c.moebius_sq_mul_ramanujanSum
header:
theorem moebius_sq_mul_ramanujanSum (q m : ℕ) :
    (ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) ^ 2 * ramanujanSum q m =
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) ^ 2 *
        ((q.totient : ℝ) * (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q m) : ℝ) /
          (q / Nat.gcd q m).totient : ℂ)
source_comment:
/-- Page 481 equation 3. The printed formula holds after the Mobius squared coefficient,
for every modulus, including nonsquarefree moduli. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400d.polynomialKernel_eq

source_comment: /-- Page 480. The kernel norm is bounded by H plus one on a nonnegative window. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.meanMajorArcs
header: def meanMajorArcs (F : ℤ[X]) (N H B : ℝ) : Set ℝ
source_comment:
/-- Page 486 before equation 26. Periodic enclosing arcs of radius one over q Q.
These contain the printed Farey cells and are the domains of the remainder mass. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.majorPrimeMean
header: def majorPrimeMean (F : ℤ[X]) (M : ℕ) (N H B : ℝ) : ℝ
source_comment: /-- Page 486 equation 26. Real part of the major arc prime mean integral. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.truncatedWeightedMean
header: def truncatedWeightedMean (F : ℤ[X]) (N H B : ℝ) : ℝ
source_comment:
/-- Pages 486 and 487 equations 27 and 28. The truncated singular mean.
The Ramanujan sum at a negative integer equals its value at that integer's absolute value.
The cutoff hypotheses in the leaves ensure nonnegative polynomial values. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.leaf_minor_mean
header:
theorem leaf_minor_mean (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (hW : Section2.WeylLemma F) (A ε : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ B₀ : ℝ, 0 < B₀ ∧ ∀ B : ℝ, B₀ ≤ B → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
      ∃ C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (6 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ) - ε) →
      (∀ n ∈ win F N H, 0 ≤ Fv F n ∧ (Fv F n).toNat ≤ ⌊c * N⌋₊) →
      |(∑ n ∈ win F N H, R (Fv F n).toNat) -
        majorPrimeMean F ⌊c * N⌋₊ N H B| ≤ C * H * N * Real.log N ^ (-A)
source_comment:
/-- LEAF. Page 486 equation 26. Parseval and the secondary Weyl decay discard the minor arcs.
This is only the comparison with the major integral, before the character expansion.
The period from zero to one is the periodic form of the printed shifted period. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.leaf_principal_mean
header:
theorem leaf_principal_mean (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (A ε B c : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) (hB : 0 < B) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (6 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ) - ε) →
      (∀ n ∈ win F N H, 0 ≤ Fv F n ∧ (Fv F n).toNat ≤ ⌊c * N⌋₊) →
      |majorPrimeMean F ⌊c * N⌋₊ N H B - truncatedWeightedMean F N H B| ≤
        C * H * (remainderMass F c N H B +
          Real.sqrt (N * Real.log N * remainderMass F c N H B)) +
        C * H * N * Real.log N ^ (-A)
source_comment:
/-- LEAF. Page 486 equation 27. Insert the principal kernel and keep the remainder mass.
Cauchy Schwarz gives the square root term. The enclosing arc variant includes
the principal kernel tail correction at the Farey cell endpoints.
This leaf does not discard the minor arcs
or replace the finite Ramanujan sum by the full singular series. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.leaf_singular_tail
header:
theorem leaf_singular_tail (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (A ε : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ B₀ : ℝ, 0 < B₀ ∧ ∀ B : ℝ, B₀ ≤ B →
      ∃ C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧ ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (6 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ) - ε) →
      |truncatedWeightedMean F N H B -
        ∑ n ∈ win F N H, (Fv F n : ℝ) * Sing (Fv F n).toNat| ≤
          C * H * N * Real.log N ^ (-A)
source_comment:
/-- LEAF. Page 487 equation 28, by the tail argument of page 481 equations 3 and 4.
Only the finite singular series is replaced by the full singular series here. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.leaf_weighted_mean
header:
theorem leaf_weighted_mean (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F)
    (A ε : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ B c C N₀ : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ 3 ≤ N₀ ∧
      ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N →
      N ^ (1 / (6 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
      H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ) - ε) →
      |(∑ n ∈ win F N H, R (Fv F n).toNat) -
        ∑ n ∈ win F N H, (Fv F n : ℝ) * Sing (Fv F n).toNat| ≤
        C * H * (remainderMass F c N H B +
          Real.sqrt (N * Real.log N * remainderMass F c N H B)) +
        C * H * N * Real.log N ^ (-A)
source_comment:
/-- Pages 486 and 487 equations 26 through 28. The exact existing weighted mean target.
CONDITIONAL ON the three smaller leaves and the existing Weyl input.
The assembly has no sorry of its own. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Decomp400e.leaf_prime_mean_estimate
header:
theorem leaf_prime_mean_estimate (F : ℤ[X]) (hF : Admissible F) :
    ∀ A ε : ℝ, 0 < A → 0 < ε → ∃ C N₀ : ℝ,
      ∀ N H : ℝ, N₀ ≤ N → N ^ (1 / (6 * (F.natDegree : ℝ)) + ε) ≤ H →
        H ≤ N ^ (1 / (F.natDegree : ℝ) - ε) →
        |(∑ n ∈ win F N H, R (Fv F n).toNat) -
          (F.leadingCoeff : ℝ) * N * ∑ n ∈ win F N H, Sing (Fv F n).toNat| ≤
            C * H * N * Real.log N ^ (-A)
source_comment:
/-- Pages 487 and 489 equations 30, 32 and 37. Reuse the existing error absorption
with the newly split weighted mean. CONDITIONAL ON its OPEN leaves,
the existing character remainder input and the higher degree Weyl input. -/
variant: enclosing rational arcs and zero to one period

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan400.ramanujanSum_prime_power_formula
header:
theorem ramanujanSum_prime_power_formula (p e m : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) :
    ramanujanSum (p ^ (e + 1)) m =
      ((p ^ (e + 1)).totient : ℂ) *
        (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (p ^ (e + 1) / Nat.gcd (p ^ (e + 1)) m) : ℂ) /
        ((p ^ (e + 1) / Nat.gcd (p ^ (e + 1)) m).totient : ℂ)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. The displayed totient and Mobius formula at a positive prime power. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan400.ramanujanSum_formula
header:
theorem ramanujanSum_formula (q m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ramanujanSum q m = (q.totient : ℂ) *
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q m) : ℂ) /
        ((q / Nat.gcd q m).totient : ℂ)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. The printed Ramanujan sum formula for every positive modulus. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan400.norm_ramanujanSum_le
header:
theorem norm_ramanujanSum_le (q m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ‖ramanujanSum q m‖ ≤ (q.totient : ℝ) / (q / Nat.gcd q m).totient
source_comment: /-- Page 481 equation 3. The Ramanujan norm is bounded by the totient quotient. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Ramanujan400.norm_weighted_ramanujanSum_le
header:
theorem norm_weighted_ramanujanSum_le (q m : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ‖((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℂ) ^ 2) * ramanujanSum q m‖ ≤
      1 / ((q.totient : ℝ) * (q / Nat.gcd q m).totient)
source_comment: /-- Page 481 equation 3. Each Mobius weighted coefficient has the printed totient majorant. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt
header: def ramanujanSumInt (q : ℕ) (m : ℤ) : ℂ
source_comment: /-- Page 481. The Ramanujan sum for an integer frequency. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt_natCast
header:
theorem ramanujanSumInt_natCast (q m : ℕ) :
    ramanujanSumInt q (m : ℤ) = Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q m
source_comment: /-- Page 481. Natural frequencies agree with the existing sum. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt_neg
header:
theorem ramanujanSumInt_neg (q : ℕ) (m : ℤ) :
    ramanujanSumInt q (-m) = conj (ramanujanSumInt q m)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. Reversing a frequency conjugates its Ramanujan sum. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt_formula
header:
theorem ramanujanSumInt_formula (q : ℕ) (m : ℤ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ramanujanSumInt q m = (q.totient : ℂ) *
      (ArithmeticFunction.moebius (q / Nat.gcd q m.natAbs) : ℂ) /
        ((q / Nat.gcd q m.natAbs).totient : ℂ)
source_comment: /-- Page 481. The printed Ramanujan formula for every integer frequency. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt_eq_natAbs
header:
theorem ramanujanSumInt_eq_natAbs (q : ℕ) (m : ℤ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    ramanujanSumInt q m = Ramanujan103.ramanujanSum q m.natAbs
source_comment: /-- Page 481 equation 3. Signed frequencies have the same value as their absolute value. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Totient400.divisor_totient_ratio_le
header:
theorem divisor_totient_ratio_le (d n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hd : d ∣ n) :
    (d : ℝ) / d.totient ≤ (n : ℝ) / n.totient
source_comment: /-- Page 481 equation 3. The ratio n over phi n increases under divisibility. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Totient400.sum_divisors_ratio_le
header:
theorem sum_divisors_ratio_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (d : ℝ) / d.totient) ≤
      (n : ℝ) * n.divisors.card / n.totient
source_comment: /-- Page 481 equation 3, final inequality for the divisor sum. -/

name: LeanLab.Perelli1996.Totient400.norm_coefficient_sum_le
header:
theorem norm_coefficient_sum_le (s : Finset ℕ) (m : ℤ) (hs : ∀ q ∈ s, 0 < q) :
    ‖∑ q ∈ s, ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q : ℂ) ^ 2 / (q.totient : ℂ) ^ 2) *
      RamanujanInt400.ramanujanSumInt q m‖ ≤
      ∑ q ∈ s, 1 / ((q.totient : ℝ) * (q / Nat.gcd q m.natAbs).totient)
source_comment:
/-- Page 481 equation 3. Finite coefficient sums obey the printed totient majorant.
No convergence claim for an infinite tail is included in this finite identity. -/
